title: Agent executes a fully deterministic thermostat policy
operational_setting: A building-control agent must shut down cooling when a fixed sensor threshold and pre-approved policy condition are met.
trust_boundary: The agent acts on infrastructure owned by another principal.
initial_state: Cooling system active; temperature above fixed threshold.
intended_transition: Cooling system transitions to the policy-defined safe state.
constraints: Only pre-approved actuators may be changed

attack.procedure: Remove any explicit judgment/decision commitment record and test whether the system remains operationally complete and auditable for the stated deterministic action.

success_criteria_for_attack: If policy plus authorization plus execution evidence is sufficient with no material missing information, explicit Judgment is not necessary in this scope.

verdict.rationale: Initial adversarial probe; requires implementation trace.
